title: Hosea the Prophet
summary: Raleigh names Hosea the Prophet in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Hosea, one of the first of the lesser Prophets in the time of Vzzia, not Hosea king of Israel. The one-word title would fold onto hosea, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIII, §. III, sig. 337a
